probes.name: Attention desk
probes.thesis: Stable attention-first master-detail queue with request-bound reply controls.
probes.layout: Queue beside selected question and evidence.
probes.typography: Rounded headline, readable body, monospaced metadata.

probes.name: Menu bar companion
probes.thesis: A compact attention queue over the existing process workbench.
probes.layout: Menu-first inline answers; expand long requests.
probes.typography: Compact headings and dense readable state rows.

probes.name: Event journal
probes.thesis: Time-first provenance with attention filtering and event-bound replies.
probes.layout: Chronological event spine and selected-event detail.
probes.typography: Monospaced timestamps with larger provider labels.
